verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's own AI-Drafted Retrospectives feature analyzes the incident's timeline, details and context. When the incident resolves, it generates a draft retrospective with an overview, timelines, impacts and preliminary Lessons Learned, and users can draft answers to individual template questions for human review. The evidence does not show that the draft covers contributing factors or follow-up action items, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: documented contributing-factor analysis, AI-generated follow-up/action items, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts the postmortem from the incident record — timeline, contributing factors, follow-ups — ready for human review

citations.quote: Upon incident resolution, AI-Drafted Retrospectives generate a comprehensive draft that includes a structured overview of the incident, timelines, impacts, and preliminary Lessons Learned.
When you click "Draft with AI" next to any question in your retrospective template, FireHydrant will: Analyze the incident's timeline, details, and context
you can use AI to generate draft answers for individual questions.
